name: Outbound Campaign Bounce/Spam Circuit Breaker (Smartlead / Instantly)

parameters.content:
## ⚠️ Disclaimer & Liability Limitation
Use at your own risk. The code, workflows, and scripts provided in this repository (`n8n-outbound-campaign-bounce-threshold-circuit-breaker`) are for educational and architectural demonstration purposes.

- **No Liability:** The author and dhRobin Systems assume no responsibility or liability for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use, misuse, or deployment of these scripts.
- **No Warranty:** All software, configuration templates, and JavaScript modules are provided "AS IS" without warranty of any kind.
- **Production Testing Required:** Always test thoroughly in an isolated staging environment with mock campaign data (`MOCK_STATS=true`, `SANDBOX_MODE=true`) before connecting live Smartlead, Instantly, or CRM credentials.

nodes.name: Hourly Health Check (Cron)
nodes.notes: Runs at minute 15 of every hour over a rolling LOOKBACK_DAYS window. Edit the cron expression to change the cadence.

nodes.name: Manual Test Run
nodes.notes: For rehearsals. Note: workflow static data (breaker state) is only persisted on production (scheduled) runs.

nodes.name: Load Mock Stats
nodes.notes: Fictional campaigns only. MOCK_STATS=true is rejected unless SANDBOX_MODE=true.

nodes.name: Smartlead: Campaign Stats
nodes.notes: One request per active campaign, 700 ms apart. Errors are reported as missing data, never as healthy.

nodes.name: Evaluate Thresholds
nodes.notes: Pure threshold logic from src/thresholdValidator.js. Breaker state lives in workflow static data.

nodes.name: Live Mode?
nodes.notes: [sandbox-gate:live-output=0] Fail-safe: only the exact value "live" can pause campaigns, scrub leads or page anyone.

nodes.name: Assert Live Mode
nodes.notes: Defense in depth: re-reads the environment before any pause or scrub.

nodes.name: Loop Over Breached Campaigns
nodes.notes: One campaign per iteration: pause, scrub, alert.

nodes.name: Smartlead: Pause Campaign
nodes.notes: Sets status PAUSED (never STOPPED, which is permanent). Idempotent, safe to retry.

nodes.name: Instantly: List Bounced Leads
nodes.notes: POST /leads/list is a read operation (filters BOUNCED, then RISKY if SCRUB_INCLUDE_RISKY=true).

nodes.name: Smartlead: Pause Bounced Lead
nodes.notes: Pauses the lead in this campaign so it cannot resume when the campaign is resumed.

nodes.name: Instantly: Block Bounced Email
nodes.notes: Adds the address to the workspace block list (affects ALL campaigns). Disable with SCRUB_LEADS=false.

nodes.name: Twilio: SMS Deliverability Engineer
nodes.notes: Campaign ID and rates only, no lead data.
